message:
feat(keepalive-r2 ②, c/d): a standby lease on the client -- one socket per host lease -- and activation as a connect mode

- ClientSessionConnectArgs::udpHandshake: the UDP handshake to run on the (prepared) socket INSTEAD of the Hello.
  Empty = the ordinary authenticated Hello, unchanged.
- StandbyLease: the lease's one UDP socket (contract §2.7: never two hosts on one socket) and its StandbyEntryClient;
  pumped by its owner (no thread of its own). ActivationArgs() hands the socket to ClientSessionController with a
  handshake that sends StandbyActivate and returns only on this activation's Pong (Granted) AND the HelloAck, either
  order; the session's ordinary path follows. SessionOver(): a new socket, the entry kept by Ping.
  Limit (in the header): through a relay the lease is bound to the old client endpoint, so after a session the
  entry is re-admitted with a new capability -- keeping the socket across a session is (3)'s.
Shipping: nothing in the apps calls it yet (automatic preconnect stays OFF).
